Text: Pumps only the coffee out of the water below and bottles it as coffee. Needs water that is at least 10% coffee.
Pumps only the healing water out of the water below and makes antidote from it. Needs water that is at least 10% healing water.
Leave the water, keep the good part.
Boils saltwater from below into clean water. Each water takes 0.3 saltwater, and the rest leaves as brine.
The salt crust is a nuisance. The water is not.
Draws healing water from deep below. Beavers wading in water that is at least 20% healing recover from injuries and contamination. Stops in droughts.
Some beavers swear by a daily soak.
A natural spring of healing water. Beavers wading in water that is at least 20% healing recover from injuries and contamination.
Erupts with fresh water for 3 hours of every 18, even during droughts and badtides.
Too much coffee: water pumps stop at 50% coffee.
Too much healing water: water pumps stop at 50% healing water.
Too salty: water pumps stop at 10% saltwater.
Hazardous weather (More Fluids). Water sources run at half strength and release coffee instead of water. Pumps stop where the water is half coffee or more.
